context: yongchivo-portfolio: personal portfolio and small browser tools site (yongchivo.com) built with Astro 4, TypeScript, TailwindCSS and DaisyUI, based on the Astrofy template. Main code in src/: pages (incl. es/ Spanish routes, convert/, analytics/, phv-prep-uk/), components, layouts, content/blog (MDX), convert/ (client-side file converters: pdf-lib, pdfjs, ffmpeg.wasm, libheif, docx-preview), analytics/, data/cv.ts. Package manager: npm (package-lock.json). Build check is `npm run build`; there is no test or lint script. Roles cannot execute commands: Uno itself runs the `build` check (`npm run build`) after each edit step and on the integration branch, and passes the result to reviewers as evidence. Keep bilingual (EN/ES) strings consistent. Do not add dependencies, change astro/tailwind config, deployment or CI without human approval. Use bounded tasks with explicit paths.
